card.name: Word 'of' after a noun or quantity
card.fires_on: The word 'of' (sometimes the space before a number) right after a quantity or noun, as in 'percent of', 'm² of', 'site(s) of'. It leads into the thing being measured or owned.

modes.label: 'of' after a measure
modes.description: 'of' follows a unit or percentage and introduces what is measured.

modes.label: 'of' after a noun
modes.description: 'of' follows a plain noun and introduces its owner or location.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The gap right before a figure after a phrase like 'average of' or 'only'.
modes.example: Black elders made an average of<< >>7.5 fewer trips to the doctor
